book.name: Markus
book.title: Vaaru poia to Yesu Krisi tau Markus iboode Mak—Mark

content: Yesu igharaat ŋeer ee tau niima imaat
Tileep le umbom patabuyaaŋ ite ivot, ra Yesu iloŋ ila rumei ee. Ve ŋeer ee ilepleep tomani zi. I niima ee imaat.
Zeran tutuuŋa siriv tilepleep tomani zi paam. Yes tighe tipayooz Yesu pa savsaveeŋ. Tauvene timarari tighe tighita: Pale igharaat moroghooŋa eta ila saawe to umbom patabuyaaŋ, ma mako?
Yesu isaav pa ŋeer tau niima imaat na ighe: “Ulam uyooz izi sene.”

Ra ighason zeran tutuuŋa tawe ighe: “Laak, ŋgar sindei tau yam aghita aghe iduduuŋ pa tutuuŋ to Maaron? Tauul tamtamon ve tagham poghani zi pa saawe to umbom patabuyaaŋ, ma tagham saghatin zi? Tagham mulin zi pa pataŋani toozi, ma tarav zi timaat?” Yesu isavia saveeŋ tane le tineneeŋ mon. Irau tiyol saveeŋ tooni mako.

Tauvene Yesu maata ila pazi toman aatyavyav. Pasaa, ŋgar toozi iyaryaaŋ kat, ve lolozi isaghatin ŋeer tana rigta mako. Eemon loolo ipataŋan pazi paam. Ra isaav pa ŋeer tau niima isaghat na ighe: “Uyoot nimam iduduuŋ.” Tauvene ŋeer tana iyoot niima le niima poia muul.
Tauta zeran tutuuŋa tau tileep tomani zi na, tiburig tivot tila muuri, ve yesŋa zeran siriv tau tipakpaak Erod pa ŋgar tooni na, tilup zi ve tiil eez pa ravuuŋ Yesu imaat.
Eval tiina titaghon Yesu

Yesu tomania mbiwa tooni tipul nugh tawe, ve tizila muul pa yaa naliu Galilaia. Ve eval tiina kat to Galilaia titaghon zi gha yesŋa tila. Ve yes mon mako. Tamtamon katini to Yudea, Yerusalem, ve Idumea, tomania tamtamon naol to nugh siriv tau tigheen ila pa yaa Yordan ziige ite na tila tomani zi. Ve taan sirivu to nugh Tiro ve Sidon tamtamona paam, tilooŋ Yesu vaaru pa gabua naol tau i ighamgham zi na, tauvene tisov tila tighe tighita.
Eval tiina tila tilivutin Yesu. Tauvene i isaav pa mbiwa tooni ighe tigham waaŋ eta ilam isaŋan pani. Ighe tamtamon tigiriŋi, o izaa waaŋ ve ila ipot soghan.
Pasaa, Yesu igharaat moroghooŋa katini gha tinizi poia wa. Tauvene tamtamon tisov tau timorooŋ na, tivagiriŋi zi tighe le titutu rigta.
Ve yes tau avuvu sasaghati tizeev zi na, saawe isov tau tighita Yesu, titaptap tizi Yesu aaghe puughu, ve tiboboob aliŋazi tiina tighe: “Yo Maaron Naatu!”
Eemon Yesu iyaon zi, ve iŋgalsekin zi ariaaŋ ighe tivotia eeza ighazooŋ sov.
Yesu ighur tamtamon saŋavul ve ru timin mbaŋooŋa tooni
Murei ra, Yesu izala pa loloz ee, ve ipoi tamtamon siriv tau i loolo pazi na, tilam tooni.

Ve ighur tamtamon saŋavul ve ru timin mbiwa tooni. Leso tileep tomania, ve murei pale imbaaŋ zi tila pa votiaaŋ vaaru poia. Ve irei tapiri irau zi, ve ighur avuvu sasaghati tisov tileep ila sambazi. Leso tiziir zi tighau.
Zeran saŋavul ve ru tawe, ezazi tauvene: Simon (i, Yesu iwaat eeza ite ighe Petrus),
ve Zebedi natŋa ru, Yakobus gha taazi Yoan. (Zeran ru tane, Yesu iwaat zi ighe ‘Boanerges.’ Ezazi tane, puughu tauvene: ‘Lalaav natŋa.’)
Ve Andreas, Pilip, Patoromai, Matayu, Tomas, Yakobus ite tau Alpai naatu na, Tadeus, Simon ite tau iyooz tomania yes Selot,
ve Yudas Iskariot tau murei ighur Yesu ila koiŋa nimazi.
Yesu koiŋa tighe i igham uraat toman Sadan tapiri
Yesu tomania mbiwa tooni timuul tila pa ruum, ve eval tiina tilam tilivut zi muul. Tauvene lezi saawe eta to ghaniiŋ mako.
Yesu ziiri waaro tooni siriv tilooŋ vaaru pa gabua naol tau i ighamgham zi na, ve tila tighe tikisi ve tighamu tila. Pasaa, tighe i daaba ikaukau.

Zeran ŋgara siriv to tutuuŋ tileep Yerusalem tilam, ve tiŋgal saveeŋ pani tighe: “Aa, ewe Belsebul tau daaba to avuvu sasaghati na izeeva ve ipaloti. Tauta i le tapiri to iziir avuvu sasaghati tighau.”
Tauvene Yesu ipoi zi tilam, ve isavia saveeŋ palelaaŋ tane pazi ighe: “Mindai, pale Sadan ighur koi pa tauu zeetŋa ve iziir zi tighau? Mako.
Isaav ighe kinik eta tomania tamtamon tooni tivaghuru koi pa tauzi ve tivalagh zi tileep lez lez, ene irau tiyooz ariaaŋ mako.
Ve ruum paam. Isaav ighe tamtamona tivaghuru koi pa tauzi ve tivalagh zi tileep lez lez, ene irau tiyooz ariaaŋ mako.
Sadan tauvene paam. Isaav ighe iburig ve igham malmal pa tauu zeetŋa, ma tamtamon tooni tivaghuru koi pa tauzi, ene irau iyooz ariaaŋ muul mako. Tapiri ighe isov.

“Tamtamon eta irau ireu ruum to ŋeer ariaaŋa eta, ve iloŋ ila iyau sorokin gabua tooni ne mako. I aat itatan ŋeer ariaaŋa tana tapiri ve ikauu pa ravraav le isov, o iyauur gabua naol isov tau tigheen iloŋ ila ruum tooni loolo.
Onoon kat yau nasaav payam: Sosor isov to tamtamon, ve saveeŋ sasaghati naol isov tau tisiki pa Maaron, ene Maaron irau ireua pazi.
Eemon isaav ighe tamtamon eta isik saveeŋ saghati iŋarui Avuvu Patabuyaaŋ tomania uraat tooni, ene sosor tauvene, Maaron irau ireua mako. Pale igheen taghon taghon gha ila.”
Yesu isavia saveeŋ naol tana pazi pasaa, yes tighe avuvu saghati izeeva.
Yesu tiina ve tazŋa
Saawe tana, Yesu tiina tomania tazŋa tilam tivot. Yes tiyooz muuri, ve timbaaŋ pa Yesu tighe ivot ila toozi.
Saawe tana, eval tiina tirou livutin Yesu. Yes tisaav pani tighe: “Ou, tinam tomania tazimŋa tilam tiyozyooz muuri we. Tighe tighit ghom.”
Yesu iyol aliŋazi ighe: “Tinaŋ sei, ve tazigŋa savunugha?”
Ra maata ila pa eval tiina tau tilivuti na, ve isaav pazi ighe: “Ene yau tinaŋŋa ve tazigŋa.
Pa sei tau ighe itaghon Maaron loolo, ene imin yau tazig, livug, ve tinaŋ.”

footnotes.text: Selot, ene lupuuŋ ee to yes Yuda tau tighe tiziir gavman to Rom tighau.
